title: Apparel Return Policy
text: Apparel products can be returned within 7 days of delivery.

title: Apparel Return Policy
text: The product should be unused and have its original tags attached.

title: Footwear Return Policy
text: Footwear products can be returned within 7 days of delivery.

title: Footwear Return Policy
text: The footwear should be unused and returned with its original packaging.

title: Electronics Return Policy
text: Eligible electronics products can be returned within 7 days of delivery.

title: Electronics Return Policy
text: Some products may require troubleshooting or verification before a return is approved.

title: Home Product Return Policy
text: Eligible home products can generally be returned within 7 days of delivery.

title: Home Product Return Policy
text: The product should be unused and available for inspection during the return process.

title: COD Refund Policy
text: For a returned COD order, the refund is processed after the returned product passes the required verification.

title: COD Refund Policy
text: The refund is sent to the customer's selected eligible refund method.

title: Delivery SLA Policy
text: The estimated delivery date shown for an order is based on the destination and available delivery service.

title: Delivery SLA Policy
text: Delivery can take longer when there are operational or logistics delays.

title: Reverse Pickup Eligibility
text: Reverse pickup is available when the product and order are eligible for return and the service is available at the delivery location.

title: Reverse Pickup Eligibility
text: The product must be packed according to the return instructions before pickup.

title: Damaged Product Policy
text: Customers should report a product that arrives damaged as soon as possible through the support process.

title: Damaged Product Policy
text: The product may be inspected before a replacement, return, or refund is approved.

title: Wrong Product Policy
text: If a customer receives a product different from the ordered item, the issue should be reported through the support process.

title: Wrong Product Policy
text: The order and product may be verified before the return or replacement is processed.

title: Exchange Policy
text: Exchange is available only for products and orders that are eligible for exchange.

title: Exchange Policy
text: Availability can depend on the product, size or variant, and stock at the time of the request.

title: Prepaid Refund Policy
text: For an eligible prepaid order, the refund is initiated after the return is approved and the required verification is completed.

title: Prepaid Refund Policy
text: The refund is processed back through the applicable payment or refund method.

title: Order Cancellation Policy
text: An order can be cancelled when the cancellation option is available for that order.

title: Order Cancellation Policy
text: Cancellation availability can change after the order moves further into the fulfilment process.
